backgroundMissing: The pre-2012 background file was not loaded, so months before February 2012 may read low.
failed: The fire record for this place could not be read.
hotspotsNote: The hotspots file holds one row per detection. It covers at most 366 days, so it opens with {year}. A point is capped at 200 km; a country or a drawn area is read as the box around it, so the file covers the box, not the exact shape.
hotspotsSlow: Large areas take a while: the file is read from the public archive.
loading: Reading the fire record for this place.
lowConfidence: This area is smaller than one grid square, so the figures are for the whole square around it.
rangeEmpty: That range holds no months. Widen it.
rangeNote: The calendar, the table and the downloads cover this range only.
satelliteCountryOnly: Counts per satellite are held for whole countries only. Pick a country to see them.
selectMonthHint: Pick a month in the calendar to change the two cards below.
